"""Multi-capture ordering, manifest layout and output structure."""
import base64, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from harness import run
from gen_targets import canary_iid
import ipaddress, json

HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,'
        'result,service,attempt,payload')

def canary(seed,lease,prefix):
    return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(prefix.split('/')[0]))
                                    +canary_iid(seed,lease,prefix.rsplit('/',1)[0]+'/64')))

def campaign(captures,leases,services=(),queries=(10,),requests=(),offers=(),
             quotas=((( 'g',None,9),),(('o',None,9),))):
    chunks=[]
    for rows in captures:
        data='\r\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\r\n'
        chunks.append([base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()])
    return {'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':list(leases),'services':list(services),
            'queries':list(queries),
            'captures':[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':c} for c in chunks],
            'requests':list(requests),'offers':list(offers),
            'request_quotas':[{'id':n[0],'parent':n[1],'capacity':n[2]} for n in quotas[0]],
            'offer_quotas':[{'id':n[0],'parent':n[1],'capacity':n[2]} for n in quotas[1]]}

fails=[]
def check(label,got,want):
    if got!=want:
        fails.append(label); print('FAIL',label,'\n  got ',got,'\n  want',want)

# manifest ordering: lexical lease, numeric subnet, canary then low IIDs
leases=[{'id':'b','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[10,2,255],
         'low_count':2},
        {'id':'a','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}]
out=run(campaign([],leases))
m=out['manifest']
check('manifest length',len(m),3*3+2)
check('manifest order',[(r['lease'],r['probe']) for r in m],
      [('a','0/c'),('a','0/i1'),
       ('b','2/c'),('b','2/i1'),('b','2/i2'),
       ('b','10/c'),('b','10/i1'),('b','10/i2'),
       ('b','255/c'),('b','255/i1'),('b','255/i2')])
# each /64 gets its own canary
check('canaries distinct',m[0]['target']!=m[2]['target']!=m[5]['target'],True)
# probe keys parse numerically in records
a_can=canary('demo','a','2001:db8::/64')
rows=['icmp,x,0,5,put,a,1,0/c,{0},{0},echo,,,'.format(a_can)]
out=run(campaign([rows],leases))
check('canary row accepted',out['rejected'],[])
check('aliased',out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['state'],'alias')
check('canary never a low',out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['unresolved'],['2001:db8::1'])

# /56 subnet offset selects the right /64
lease56={'id':'s','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[1],
         'low_count':1}
out=run(campaign([],leases=(lease56,)))
check('subnet offset',out['manifest'][1]['target'],'2001:db8:1:1201::1')
check('subnet canary',out['manifest'][0]['target'],
      canary('demo','s','2001:db8:1:1201::/56'))

# rejected indices across captures keep capture then record order
L={'id':'L','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}
rows1=['icmp,ok,0,5,put,L,1,0/i1,2001:db8::1,2001:db8::1,echo,,,','junk']
rows2=['icmp,ok,0,5,put,L,1,0/i1,2001:db8::1,2001:db8::1,open,,,','other,junk,here']
out=run(campaign([rows1,rows2],leases=(L,)))
check('rejected order',out['rejected'],[[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]])
check('live across captures',out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],
      {'live':2,'deleted':0,'conflict':0})

# addresses are numerically increasing and distinct
L2={'id':'M','prefix':'2001:db8:ffff::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0,255],
    'low_count':8}
rows=[f'icmp,ok,0,5,put,M,1,0/i{n},2001:db8:ffff:0::{n},2001:db8:ffff:0::{n},echo,,,' for n in range(1,9)]
rows+=[f'icmp,o{a},0,5,put,M,1,255/i{a},2001:db8:ffff:ff00::{a},2001:db8:ffff:ff00::{a},echo,,,' for a in range(1,9)]
out=run(campaign([rows],leases=(L,)))
entry=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]
check('internal sorted',entry['internal'],
      [f'2001:db8:ffff:0::{n}' for n in range(1,9)])
entry=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][1]
check('internal sorted 2',entry['internal'],
      [f'2001:db8:ffff:ff00::{a}' for a in range(1,9)])
# lexical lease and service ordering in the snapshot
leases=[{'id':'zz','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':10,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1},
        {'id':'aa','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':10,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}]
out=run(campaign([],leases,services=[{'id':'z','kind':'tcp'},{'id':'a','kind':'adb'}]))
check('lease order',[e['lease'] for e in out['snapshots'][0]['leases']],['aa','zz'])
check('service order',[s['id'] for s in out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services']],
      ['a','z'])
check('service keys',set(out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]),
      {'id','internal_open','internal_closed','external_open','external_closed',
       'internal_only','protocol_errors'})
check('snapshot keys',set(out['snapshots'][0]),
      {'at','ledger','unbound_applications','leases'})
check('result keys',set(out),
      {'manifest','rejected','snapshots','active_requests','plan'})
print('multi tests done, failures:',len(fails))
PYEOF
